title: Get an AI key from OpenRouter

steps.title: Create an OpenRouter account
steps.description: Open OpenRouter and sign up with your email, Google or GitHub.

pointer.where: top-right corner of openrouter.ai, then choose to sign up

steps.title: Add credits
steps.description: Add a small amount to start. Each request uses a little, depending on the model.

steps.title: Create a key with a limit
steps.description: Name it MakeItOurs and set a credit limit so it can never spend more than you choose.

pointer.where: Settings › API Keys, the button for a new key

steps.title: Copy the key and keep it private
steps.description: Copy it straight away. Treat it like a password and never share it, not even with MakeItOurs support.

pointer.where: beside your new key, shown right after you create it

steps.title: Paste it into MakeItOurs
steps.description: Mac: project menu, AI Settings…. iPhone: project menu, Set Up Remote AI. Choose OpenRouter and paste the key.

pointer.where: AI Settings (Mac) or Remote AI Setup (iPhone), with Provider set to OpenRouter

steps.title: Pick a model and save
steps.description: Press Fetch Models, choose a model, then save. MakeItOurs is ready to take requests.

pointer.where: under Model, then Save (Mac) or Save Selection (iPhone)
